policy_tiers.tier_1_majority: When >=2 workers agree on the same contentHash, pick that hash. Chosen workerId = lexicographically smallest among the winners.
policy_tiers.tier_2_lexicographic_fallback: When no majority (all disagree or tie in counts), pick the lexicographically smallest workerId among ALL versions. Arbitrary but transparent.
policy_tiers.tier_0_no_conflict: When all versions have the same hash (or single version), no conflict, no resolution.
